import pytest
from rich.console import Console
from rich.measure import Measurement
from rich.text import Text


@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    "text,expected_min,expected_max",
    [
        ("Hello", 5, 5),
        ("你好", 4, 4),  # Two double-width characters
        ("Hello你好", 9, 9),  # Five single-width, two double-width
        ("H你好o", 7, 7),  # One single, two double, one single
        ("", 0, 0),
        (" ", 1, 1),
        ("😽", 2, 2),  # Emoji, double-width
        ("Hello😽", 7, 7),
    ],
)
def test_double_width_character_measurement(text, expected_min, expected_max):
    """
    Test that Measurement.get correctly calculates the width of text containing
    double-width characters.
    """
    console = Console(width=100)  # Arbitrary width, should not affect intrinsic measurement
    options = console.options
    measurement = Measurement.get(console, options, Text(text))

    assert measurement.minimum == expected_min
    assert measurement.maximum == expected_max
